goal: Implement the first frame-native passto-planner bootstrap vertical slice with bounded nested expert execution and planner-owned handoff artifacts.
task: Implement the initial runtime scaffold for extensions/passto-planner/, including planner contracts, planning type boundary, one technical-architecture perspective, nested execution guards/bridge, planner-owned synthesis artifact writing, structured planner result shaping, and an initial planner-to-builder handoff artifact aligned with the .passto-ai project workspace protocol.
constraints: Implement in extensions/passto-planner/ as a frame-native planner executor rather than reviving the legacy linear planner structure.
Run through passto-executor rather than bypassing it.
Support planningType values standalone-product and pi-ecosystem-product from the start.
Use exactly one bounded expert child perspective in the first slice, preferably technical-architecture.
Planner must retain ownership of synthesis, artifact writing, and planner-to-builder handoff shaping.
Planner-owned artifacts should target the shared .passto-ai workspace protocol.
Avoid broad executor rewrites unless a tiny seam proves necessary during the slice.
Keep scope bounded to the first meaningful bootstrap milestone.

checklist.text: Create minimal planner contracts and result types for the bootstrap slice
Introduce explicit planning-type normalization and validation
Create one perspective definition for technical-architecture
Implement a bounded nested child execution bridge and guard layer
Write planner-owned synthesis artifacts under the shared .passto-ai workspace
Emit a structured planner result with parent-child run linkage
Emit an initial planner-handoff artifact suitable for future builder consumption
Add one command/tool entry surface and focused bootstrap tests
